verdict.rationale: Meltano's self-hosted model ('own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers') implies users inherently control where data and state are stored and can delete it themselves, but there is no explicit documentation of retention policies, data deletion commands, or privacy controls for extracted/replicated data or pipeline state. Missing for 10: explicit data retention/deletion feature docs, state/data purge commands, GDPR/compliance guidance, and any first-party statement on data lifecycle management.
